settings.row_text: Said it became an easy daily habit

settings.title: The Proof Is In The Peptides
settings.text: Real feedback from real customers who made Collagen part of their daily routine.
settings.caption: Results reflect self-reported customer feedback and may vary.

settings.title: Hydrolyzed Collagen Peptides
settings.text: Broken down through hydrolysis into smaller peptide chains, this form is significantly easier for your body to absorb and put to use compared to whole collagen protein. It works from within to support skin elasticity, hydration, and a naturally firmer-looking complexion. With consistent daily use, it also supports the structural proteins that keep hair and nails strong.

settings.title: Vitamin C
settings.text: Vitamin C is an essential cofactor your body needs to synthesize its own collagen, which is why we include it alongside the peptides rather than leaving it out. Together, they support a healthy, radiant-looking complexion from the inside. It's a small addition that helps the entire formula work the way it's designed to.

settings.title: Hyaluronic Acid
settings.text: Hyaluronic Acid is known for its ability to hold onto moisture, helping skin look plumper and more hydrated throughout the day. It complements collagen's hydrating benefits rather than duplicating them, rounding out the formula's support for smoother, more supple-looking skin. Together, the two work toward the same goal from different angles.

settings.title: Zero Fillers
settings.text: We formulate without artificial sweeteners, dyes, or unnecessary fillers that add bulk but no benefit. Every ingredient in the blend is there because it serves a purpose, not because it's cheap to include. That means what you're getting is a clean, effective formula with nothing hiding in the fine print.

settings.title: Step 1: Measure
settings.text: Scoop one full serving of Collagen using the scoop included in your package. There's no need to guess or measure separately — it's designed to take the thinking out of your daily routine. One scoop is all it takes to get your full daily dose.

settings.title: Step 2: Mix
settings.text: Stir it into water, coffee, tea, or your favorite smoothie until it's fully dissolved. It blends easily into hot or cold drinks without clumping, so you can add it to whatever you're already drinking. There's no need for a blender or any special equipment.

settings.title: Step 3: Enjoy Daily
settings.text: Drink it once a day, ideally around the same time, to build it into a habit you'll actually stick with. Consistency matters more than timing — morning, afternoon, or evening all work, as long as it becomes routine. Most customers notice the best results after several weeks of daily use.

settings.heading: How long until I see results?
settings.row_content: Most customers report noticeable improvements in skin hydration and elasticity within 4-6 weeks of consistent daily use. Everyone's body responds a little differently, so some people notice changes sooner while others take a bit longer. The key is sticking with it daily rather than using it sporadically. We recommend giving it at least a full 6-8 week cycle before deciding whether it's working for you.

settings.heading: Is this safe to take every day?
settings.row_content: Yes, Collagen is formulated for daily use as part of a normal routine. It's made without artificial fillers or harsh additives, so it's designed to be gentle enough for consistent, long-term use. As always, if you have any underlying health conditions, are pregnant or nursing, or are taking other medications, we recommend checking with your doctor before starting any new supplement.

settings.heading: Does it have a taste?
settings.row_content: It has a light, neutral taste that blends easily into most drinks without overpowering the flavor. Most customers say they can barely notice it in coffee, tea, or smoothies. If you're mixing it into plain water, you may notice a very subtle taste, but it's mild enough that it shouldn't be off-putting.

settings.heading: Can I take it with other supplements?
settings.row_content: Yes, Collagen can be combined with most daily supplements and vitamins without any issue. It's a simple protein-based formula, so it doesn't typically interact with other common supplements. That said, if you're on a specific supplement regimen or have any concerns, it's always a good idea to check with your healthcare provider.

settings.text: A few seconds each morning is all it takes. Stir one scoop into your coffee, water, or smoothie, and let it dissolve completely before your first sip. There's no elaborate routine to follow and nothing complicated to remember — just a small, consistent habit that fits into whatever your morning already looks like. Over time, that simple ritual is what allows the peptides to keep doing their work quietly in the background, day after day.

settings.caption: 01 — Formula
settings.heading: Peptides That Actually Absorb
settings.text: Not all collagen is created equal. Ours is hydrolyzed into smaller peptides that are easier for your body to break down and actually absorb, rather than sitting undigested. We pair it with Vitamin C, an essential cofactor your body needs to support its own natural collagen production, so the formula works with your biology instead of against it. The result is a supplement built around how skin, hair, and nail structure actually forms, not just a trendy ingredient on a label.

settings.caption: 02 — Routine
settings.heading: Built For Real Life
settings.text: No pills to remember, no complicated multi-step process, and nothing that requires you to change your entire morning. Just stir it into your coffee, tea, water, or smoothie, and you're done in under a minute. Because it fits so easily into a routine you already have, it's far easier to stay consistent with — and consistency is what actually determines whether you see results.
